statement: Determinism: the same inputs at the same frame timestamps give the same state and outputs; a frame opens only when work is due at the committed clock. The Quint cell holds the canonical order of a frame's inputs and the idle gate (a frame opens only when an input is due); that the same inputs at the same timestamps give the same state and outputs is not a property of the spec.
